notes: *the whole earth*: the present article on אֶרֶץ takes the written *the* under rule 29's fronting clause, and the construct כֹּל keeps only *whole*.

Temporal כְּ before the infinitive construct takes the *When* and the infinitive keeps the verb (rule 52); the final לְ is silenced by the ASV's bare object *make thee desolate* (rule 40), its suffix keeping *thee*.
